claim.claim-text: 1. A method for treating tissue comprising:
2. A surgical instrument for coagulating and dissecting tissue, the surgical instrument comprising:

an ultrasonic transducer acoustically coupled to the ultrasonic blade and configured to receive a drive signal from a generator to cause ultrasonic motion of the ultrasonic blade and deliver ultrasonic energy to the ultrasonic blade; wherein the processor is configured to:

3. A generator for delivering energy to a surgical instrument for coagulating and dissecting tissue, the surgical instrument comprising an end effector at a distal end thereof, the end effector configured to interact with tissue, the end effector comprising a clamp arm, an ultrasonic blade, an ultrasonic transducer acoustically coupled to the ultrasonic blade and configured to receive a drive signal from the generator to cause ultrasonic motion of the ultrasonic blade and deliver ultrasonic energy to the ultrasonic blade, the generator comprising:
4. The method of claim 1, further comprising delivering the energy signal according to the control technique.
5. The method of claim 1, wherein generating the control technique comprises correlating specific tissue characteristics with delivery of the energy signal.
6. The method of claim 1, wherein generating the control technique comprises generating the control technique in real time.
7. The method of claim 1, wherein the control technique is configured to deliver the energy signal so the tissue impedance matches a threshold impedance value.
8. The method of claim 1, wherein the control technique is configured to deliver the energy signal so the tissue impedance matches a predetermined rate of change.
9. The method of claim 1, wherein the at least one tissue parameter comprises a tissue type, a tissue amount, a tissue state, or a combination thereof.

10. The surgical instrument of claim 2, or the generator or claim 3, wherein the processor is configured to control deliver delivery of RF energy to the electrode or ultrasonic energy to the ultrasonic blade according to the control technique.

11. The surgical instrument of claim 2, or the generator of claim 3, wherein the processor is configured to correlate specific tissue characteristics with delivery of RF energy to the electrode or ultrasonic energy to the ultrasonic blade.
12. The surgical instrument of claim 2, or the generator of claim 3, wherein the processor is configured to generate the control technique in real time.

13. The surgical instrument of claim 2, or the generator of claim 3, wherein the control technique is configured to control delivery of RF energy to the electrode or ultrasonic energy to the ultrasonic blade so the tissue impedance matches a threshold impedance value.

14. The surgical instrument of claim 2, or the generator of claim 3, wherein the control technique is configured to control delivery of RF energy to the electrode or ultrasonic energy to the ultrasonic blade so the tissue impedance matches a predetermined rate of change.
15. The surgical instrument of claim 2, wherein the at least one tissue parameter comprises a tissue type, a tissue amount, a tissue state, or a combination thereof.
